description:
The user answered fz-9e2.3's design question (relayed by Binary Handling on 2026-11-19): fix it generally. The user then approved the fz-9e2.14 page (/Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-9e2-14.html, relayed by Binary Handling 2026-11-20), including folding in the fresh-arm join proposal. Owner: Binary Handling.

## Why
#806 (fz-9e2.3) shows proven constructions costing about 9 instructions more per iteration (probes 04b, 05a, 06a, 06b). Ownership judged a joined value as overlapping everything any deliverer could hold: a raise arm's call return and a fresh value arm (e.g. a fresh [1]) both made the joined value Share.

## Done when
A joined value overlaps what one of its deliverers overlaps, each judged by its own origin (jobs/body.rs; no spec read), on all three paths. Two drive tests (raise arm, held value) fail on develop and pass. With #806 on top, 04b/05a/06a/06b equal develop on the bench. The cost in jobs and pins is measured (census: no pin moves).

comments.text: Stacks on fz-bpd. After fz-bpd, a resume's layout reads only value_origin(payload), built from delivered_value_joins, so a filter on join sources reaches resume layouts with no second change. Before it, a resume aliasing its last delivering call bypasses the filter. fz-bpd also deletes artifact.rs's separate diverges filter, because the origin's Join already tolerates a never-returning raise member (Bugs and Cleanup).

Findings (Binary Handling, develop 10f9a175d). (1) The problem is general: an if whose else raises gives a loop body 6 Shares against 1 with no join. raise expands to panic/1 :: never, so this ticket covers raise arms. (2) fz-bpd's diverges note does not reach it: ownership (construct_call_ownership, values_overlap → origin_source_path) is decided in the untyped body job, where a Join with differing alternatives has no source path and so overlaps everything. That job sees only DirectCallee::Function(FunctionId). Reading the callee's declared contract there is the open design question, and the page measures its cost.

Hypothesis for the page (Binary Handling): overlap with a Join is the overlap of any one of its alternatives, each judged by its own source path. A fresh construction overlaps only its children. __construction_failed__'s return is a CallsiteReturn, already its own root in origin_source_path, so no callee spec read is needed. If the probes (06b, raise arm, value arm) confirm it, this is one data-model change covering the fresh-arm proposal too.

title: A value joined from several deliverers overlaps only what one of them holds
